title: FLASK_DEBUG env variable no longer works as of click 8.4.0
author: crono782
body_preview: **Description of bug:**  FLASK_DEBUG=1 was working previously to set flask's debug mode either in a .env/.flaskenv and using python-dotenv OR by manually setting with export FLASK_DEBUG=1.
